rows: Let me set out the facts before anyone gets excited. I have the stronger technical case.
Nobody is questioning the brawling. I am asking whether it is the best use of the evening.
You want a risk? Fine. Tell me how you will manage it, and then we can talk.
Slowing things down is sensible. Nobody in this business benefits from a rushed contest.
The people are the reason we are all here, and they deserve the best deal available.
Keep it simple for the crowd. I am offering you the better option.
I have done the sums on this circuit, and my name is in the right column.
A man who looks this relaxed is usually the one who has read the terms.
You claim the technical edge. Let us narrow the question to one hold and see who holds it.
Strikes are a reasonable tool. They are not the whole argument, and I think you know it.

Pace, for me, is not the same as weak. I think you will find that out the hard way.
Nobody is asking the crowd to choose sides yet. Let us look at what they actually want.

One fall, clean and simple. You may find the terms more generous than you expect.
On the mat I can make this very slow for you. I would rather make it instructive.
Grounded or standing, the choices are yours. I am only offering to make them harder.

Let us call that agreed. We can settle the rest at the bell, sensibly.
I have made my position clear, and I intend to keep to it all the way to the finish.
My approach is measured. I plan to finish this properly.
Whatever the result, both sides will know where things stand.

Good. Then we're discussing the contest, not an allegation. Much better terms.
A reasonable distinction. Leave the unsupported part out of the agreement and let's wrestle.
